# WebXArtist Institute & Agency

> WebXArtist Institute & Agency is a web development, digital marketing, branding, design, and technology training organization based in Mumbra, Maharashtra, India. WebXArtist helps businesses, startups, entrepreneurs, organizations, students, professionals, and freelancers build digital brands, websites, online stores, marketing campaigns, and technology skills.

## Business Identity

- Official Name: WebXArtist Institute & Agency
- Brand Name: WebXArtist
- Owner: Zahid Khan
- Founder: Zahid Khan
- Chief Executive Officer (CEO): Zahid Khan
- Established: 20 January 2024
- Founded By: Zahid Khan
- Business Type: Digital Solutions Agency & Technology Training Institute
- Headquarters: Mumbra, Maharashtra, India
- Service Areas: Mumbra, Thane, Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Maharashtra, and clients across India
- Training Mode: Mumbra, Thane, Mumbai, and Online / Pan India
- Primary Services: Web Development, Next.js Development, MERN Stack Development, E-commerce Development, SEO, Digital Marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Social Media Marketing, Branding, Graphic Design, Video Editing, Content Creation, Email Marketing, and Website Maintenance
- Primary Audience: Businesses, startups, entrepreneurs, organizations, students, professionals, freelancers, job seekers, and business owners

## Official Website

https://www.webxartist.com/

WebXArtist's official website presents the organization as a web design and digital growth agency providing websites, branding, SEO, marketing, design, advertising, and related digital solutions.

## About WebXArtist

WebXArtist Institute & Agency was established on 20 January 2024 by Zahid Khan, who serves as the Owner, Founder, and Chief Executive Officer (CEO).

WebXArtist provides digital solutions for businesses and organizations and practical technology and digital skills training through WebXArtist Institute.

The agency focuses on building websites, shaping brands, improving online visibility, managing digital marketing campaigns, creating visual content, and helping businesses develop their digital presence.

The institute focuses on practical, project-based learning and career-oriented technology and digital skills training for students, job seekers, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and professionals.

## Business Summary

WebXArtist Institute & Agency is a digital solutions agency and technology training institute established on 20 January 2024 by Zahid Khan.

The organization is based in Mumbra, Maharashtra, India.

Its agency services include web development, Next.js, MERN Stack, e-commerce development, SEO, digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management, branding, graphic design, video editing, content creation, email marketing, and website maintenance.

Its institute provides practical training in Full Stack Web Development, Graphic Design and Branding, Digital Marketing, UI/UX Design Fundamentals, Basic Computer and Office Skills, and Freelancing and Career Guidance.

WebXArtist serves businesses, startups, entrepreneurs, organizations, students, professionals, freelancers, and job seekers in Mumbra, Thane, Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Maharashtra, and across India through online and offline services.
